summary: The compliance review of SakhiCredit's product found several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. A high severity issue was identified where the app does not inform borrowers of their right to escalate rejected complaints to the RBI Ombudsman through the CMS portal. Another high severity issue was found regarding the sharing of personal information with an insurance partner without obtaining explicit consent from borrowers. Additionally, multiple medium severity issues were identified related to the absence of a privacy policy on the website, with the company planning to publish one next year.
